intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes race condition in ep_remove() by using safe file reference acquisition with automatic cleanup instead of direct struct field access.
intent_record.what: Replaced direct file pointer access with epi_fget() call and added __free(fput) annotation for automatic reference release. Changed early exit logic from checking epi->dying under file lock to checking if file reference acquisition succeeded.
intent_record.how: Ensures safe file reference acquisition before proceeding with removal operations. Prevents use-after-free by verifying file validity through epi_fget() rather than direct struct access. Automatic cleanup via __free(fput) guarantees fput() is called on function exit.
